The first comrade of Guillotine the Hero, also known as Ice Rose.
In their quest to defeat the White Ice Dragon, she leads the group onto the right path.

lines.text: What's our quest for today?
The mask? In this land of such fecundity, there is no need for such a thing.

You say my outfit is too revealing?
You just don't get it. The more revealing the clothing, the higher the defense.
Playing as a team is better than going solo.
Nothing beats a mage that can tank and deal damage at the same time.

This magic circle engraved on my tongue?
Hmm... Would you like to have a taste?
How can you leave top-tier talent like me standing around idly?
Time is money, Commander!
Is PvP possible in this area?

Can I break that chest? 
I feel like there's something good inside.

Objection! ... Sorry.
I've programmed a macro for that line to sound out whenever I see a courthouse.

A cold chill, ruthless yet warm... The Ice Rose.
I, Maiden, shall join you.
My power is overflowing!
Heh, would you like to measure my power?
You've dumped all my points into attack. Then again, I'm a power mage!
I didn't expect events where we'd increase our fondness.

Why would you give me this...? Oh, it's our anniversary today, isn't it?
Our wedding anniversary, that is.
Congratulations. You've successfully conquered the heroine.

Shall I let you in on a little spoiler?
I'm going to be the Commander's main heroine.
Commander, where should we set up our first home as newlyweds?

Adventures are best shared with those who are on the same page.
Would you like to go on a journey, just the two of us?
Are you asking me to be your companion?
Go ahead and issue the order.
Help me find a shortcut, if at all possible.
Let's start the dungeon crawl!
Let's finish it with a flourish!
Have you figured out the patterns yet?
Is everyone ready?
Let me recharge my mana.
Does anyone need a potion?
You take the aggro role for a second.
I'll freeze everything.
A decimating breath. Diamond Dust.
Let's do as much damage as possible!
I want the last strike.
Frozen solid.
Looks like I've dealt the most damage.
Heh!
Eeep!
Wrong move!
I was the weakest in our squad...
Commander, our adventure starts now!
